messages:
Maya (PM): 15m sync: we need to finalize scope for the observability rollout. Key asks from customers: per-tenant cost time-series, trace linking in error views, and exportable CSVs. Ops warns about egress and storage.
Arjun (Eng): Proposal: two dashboard templates (Route Cost Timeline, Error Regression Lens), light trace hook to attach tenant_id and route, sampling ladder: default 0.5% -> pilot 5% -> short spike window 20% for 1h. Keep sampled traces TTL=7d.
Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: default 0.5% is ok but spike windows must be gated by tokens and manual approval for >10%. Auto-cut at 60% of trace budget and alert #eng-oncall. Add a synthetic test in CI that simulates 10x sampling to validate throttles.
Ben (Data): Per-tenant cost Phase A: estimated time-series computed from aggregates (tokens, compute-ms, model_unit_price). We'll surface a confidence band. Exact per-span billing is Phase B (requires schema work, ~2 sprints). CSV export from Phase A OK.
Zoe (Design): UX: show "Estimated" badge + confidence pill (low/medium/high). Route Cost Timeline should let users zoom to route + timeframe and export CSV. Error Regression Lens shows top error fingerprints + sample traces.
Nate (CS): Pilot customers (AcmeHealth, FinTrack, NovaApps) will accept estimates if labeled. They want a one-click CSV for QBRs and the ability to temporarily increase sampling for debugging. We'll coordinate approvals.
Lenny (VP Prod): Tradeoff call: prioritize low friction for customers vs ops safety. Recommend pilot-first with strict caps and an easy escalation path for SRE to grant higher sampling for triage.
Maya (PM): Draft launch acceptance criteria: 
- Dashboards: Route Cost Timeline + Error Regression Lens render with synthetic and pilot data
- Tracing: tenant_id + route in spans; default sample_rate 0.5%; spike window support behind manual-approved tokens
- Cost: estimated per-tenant daily & monthly time-series + CSV export + confidence band
- Errors: top-10 fingerprints + ability to view up to N sampled traces per fingerprint
- Safety: per-tenant daily cap 1000 traces, auto-throttle at 60% quota, CI synthetic test for 10x sampling
Arjun (Eng): :thumbsup: from Eng. Implementation note: threading tenant_id through the request pipeline needs a small change in runtime middleware; estimate 3 days. Will open branch feature/obs-cost-traces.
Priya (SRE): :thumbsup: from SRE if caps and manual approval flow exist. I'll own throttle rules + alerting and add the synthetic CI test. ETA 4 days.
Ben (Data): :thumbsup: from Data. I'll produce the aggregate mapping plan and a sample dataset. Will mark CSV as "estimated" and include confidence field. ETA 3 days.
Zoe (Design): :thumbsup: from Design. I'll post final mocks and copy for the confidence pill by tomorrow AM.
Nate (CS): I'll own pilot onboarding and the support playbook for escalation requests. Will share pilot list today.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #1435 queued for branch feature/obs-cost-traces (1955555700)
Maya (PM): Final decision: ship Phase A (estimated cost + sampled traces + dashboards) behind feature flag to pilot customers only. Action items: Arjun (tenant tagging PR + UI toggle) 3d, Priya (throttle/alerts + CI test) 4d, Ben (agg tables + CSV) 3d, Zoe (mocks + microcopy) tomorrow AM, Nate (pilot comms & playbook) EOD. If blockers appear, escalate to #eng-oncall and drop notes here. Thank you!
